title: Part VIII
author: David Hume
summary: Philo revives the Epicurean hypothesis: matter in endless motion, given infinite time, might fall into the stable order we now see. Every religious system meets as great difficulties as this one, he concludes, so suspense of judgment is our only reasonable course.

notes.note: Epicurus (341–270 BC) explained the world as the chance combination of atoms moving in the void.
